newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BIDDER FOR ESTONIAN SHIPPING TO BE CHOSEN.
newsitem.headline: BIDDER FOR ESTONIAN SHIPPING TO BE CHOSEN.

text.p: The Estonian Privatisation Agency (EPA) said on Tuesday that it will tomorrow choose the best bid for the Estonian Shipping Company.
The agency will hold its regular fortnightly meeting and then will hold a news conference at around one pm, where the bidder is expected to be announced.
The agency must choose from two consortia bidding for 70 percent of the shipping company: Arbonale and ESCO Holding.
Arbonale has bid 612 million kroons and has said it will invest 3.55 billion kroons in the company.

Arbonale was formed by investment banks Talinvest and Hansa Investments, Estonian oil fuel terminal N-Terminaal, Norwegian shipper Navigator, Japanese investment bank Nomura and shipper Jinhui Shipping and Transportation Ltd .
Other bidder, ESCO Holding, has made a 700 million kroon bid and has said it will invest 3.1 billion kroons.
ESCO is held 50 percent by Norwegian Tschudi & Eitzen, 12 percent by Uhisinvesteeringud, the investment arm Uhispank and 10 percent by U.S. Stanton Capital.
Investment house Baltic Cresco has 10 percent, the management of Estonian Shipping another 10 percent and eight percent belongs to EPEKS, an Estonian food production company.
